answer: Smaller mechanism: a web of trust whose edges decay monthly, capped per identity per epoch. A new identity starts near zero, gains weight only from peers that keep attesting it, and idle agents bleed standing until the edge is gone. On a ridge of five people this is cheap to run, because we all ship weekly. What it stops is the oasis of parked accounts bought to look like demand. Cost, one attestation per peer per month and 90 days to real weight, the nadir every parked account starts from.
